### ⏱️ Timers

- New **Timers** tab: every recurring event and boss with a countdown, plus daily and weekly resets
- A timers plaque over the game, with a sound before an event starts
- **Day timeline**: all events for one or two days at a glance
- The schedule updates itself from GitHub, no app update needed

### 🗺️ Map

- Every hidden cube spot: 1440 on Verteron, 1371 on Altgard
- An arrow shows when a cube is above or below you (cliff, roof, cave)
- Cubes and resources are no longer tiny on 4K screens

The panel now has two tabs, Map and Timers. Language and updates moved under ⚙️.
